description: Represents a single pane inside a DockManager layout.

members.name: CanClose
members.description: Whether the pane shows a close button.

members.name: CanFloat
members.description: Whether the pane can be floated into an overlay window.

members.name: FloatX
members.description: Horizontal position for floating panes (CSS pixels).

members.name: FloatY
members.description: Vertical position for floating panes (CSS pixels).

members.name: Height
members.description: Desired height in pixels when docked to top/bottom or floating.

members.name: Icon
members.description: Optional icon name (registered in the icon system).

members.name: IsActive
members.description: Whether the pane is the active tab in its group.

members.name: IsVisible
members.description: Whether the pane is currently visible.

members.name: Order
members.description: Display order within the same docking position.

members.name: Title
members.description: Display title shown in the pane header.

members.name: Width
members.description: Desired width in pixels when docked to left/right or floating.
